settings.subtitle: Configure how OwnTracks reports locations to Homey. The configuration here needs to match the settings in the OwnTracks app.

mqtt.brokerUrl: Broker URL. The broker needs to be accessible from Homey and on the internet for the phone to connect.
mqtt.useTls: Use TLS (mqtts://) - required by most cloud brokers, typically on port 8883

settings.footerNote: Each paired "User" device has its own OwnTracks username / HTTP endpoint URL, shown on that device's Advanced Settings page.

avatars.intro: Add user to Homey using the normal Add device flow. Then upload a photo for each paired user, shown as their marker on the OwnTracks map.
avatars.noUsers: No users paired yet. Add a "User" device to upload an avatar for them.

zones.intro: Zones/waypoints are synced to and from every user's OwnTracks app, so everyone shares the same regions (e.g. for the Presence alarm).
zones.name: Name
zones.mapHint: Click the map to set the zone's location:
zones.fillInRequired: Please fill in a name, latitude and longitude

logs.intro: The last ~20KB of logged messages, newest at the bottom (not persisted across app restarts). Errors are always captured.
logs.enable: Enable log messages (in addition to errors)

addUser.title: Add a user
addUser.subtitle: Create a device to track a family member's location
addUser.name: Name
addUser.note: Use this User ID as the OwnTracks username (MQTT), or in the HTTP endpoint URL configured in the app settings.
addUser.fillInRequired: Please fill in a name and a user ID

done.title: User added
done.subtitle: Now set up the OwnTracks app for this user
done.mqttNote: Set the connection mode to MQTT (Private), point it at the broker configured in the app settings, and set the Username to:
done.httpNote: Set the connection mode to HTTP and use this endpoint URL:
done.couldNotLoadEndpoint: Could not load endpoint, see app settings
